i1.title: Mercedes-Benz The Move Eau de Toilette 60ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Fresh, free-spirited and always on the go.

Mercedes-Benz The Move Eau de Toilette 60ml is an aromatic fougère fragrance for men, created by perfumer Dominique Ropion. Spicy cardamom opens with energy, a heart of geranium and salty marine notes brings a fresh, open-air feel, and it settles onto tonka bean and balsam fir.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Cardamom
  • Heart: Geranium, Sea Salt Notes
  • Base: Tonka Bean, Balsam Fir

Key details

  • Brand: Mercedes-Benz
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 60ml
  • Scent profile: Aromatic · Fougère
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • An energetic cardamom opening
  • A fresh geranium and sea salt heart
  • A warm tonka bean and balsam fir base
  • A handy 60ml Eau de Toilette

FAQ

What does The Move smell like?

Cardamom first, then geranium and sea salt notes, finishing with tonka bean and balsam fir.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.

i2.title: Mercedes-Benz Ultimate Eau de Parfum 75ml
i2.descriptionHtml:
Warm, aromatic and quietly powerful.

Mercedes-Benz Ultimate Eau de Parfum 75ml is an amber aromatic woody fragrance for men, created by perfumer Olivier Cresp and launched in 2022. Lavender and cedar leaf open fresh and aromatic, a heart of crisp apple, mandarin and nutmeg adds a juicy, spicy warmth, and it settles onto a rich base of sandalwood, cypress, patchouli and amber.

i3.title: Mercedes-Benz Woman In Red Eau de Parfum 20ml
i3.descriptionHtml:
Bold, sensual and impossible to ignore.

Mercedes-Benz Woman In Red Eau de Parfum 20ml is an oriental floral fragrance for women, created by perfumer Honorine Blanc and launched in 2021. Juicy mandarin and pear open bright and sweet, touches of pistachio and cherry blossom add a gourmand softness, a heart of jasmine sambac and gardenia brings rich white florals, and it settles onto a warm base of tonka bean, benzoin, patchouli and sandalwood. The 20ml size is perfect for your handbag or travel.

i7.title: Mont Blanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 200ml
i7.descriptionHtml:
A bold call to adventure.

Mont Blanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 200ml is a woody aromatic leather fragrance for men, launched in 2019 and created by perfumers Jordi Fernandez, Antoine Maisondieu and Olivier Pescheux. Bergamot, Pomarose and sage open fresh and adventurous, a heart of vetiver, leather and sandalwood brings depth, and it settles onto a warm base of patchouli, Ambrofix and Akigalawood. The 200ml bottle is great value for a daily signature.
